tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass to detect foreign particles, colour and compliance with the visual specification.

details.reference: BP 2024 (SC IV K.) Characters Section in Monographs; BP 2024 Monograph for Purified Honey

tests.procedure: TLC on silica gel plate. Test solution: 0.6 g in 50 mL ethanol (30 per cent V/V). Reference solution: 0.5 g fructose, 0.5 g glucose and 0.1 g sucrose in 100 mL ethanol (30 per cent V/V). Mobile phase: water and acetonitrile (13:87 V/V). Apply 5 uL as bands; develop 3 times over 15 cm; dry in warm air. Spray with 2 g diphenylamine and 2 mL aniline in 100 mL acetone, add 850 g/L phosphoric acid until the precipitate dissolves (about 15-20 mL). Examine in daylight after heating at 100-105 C for 5-10 min. Compare the zone sequence (fructose intense brown; glucose intense greyish-blue; sucrose brown; 2 to 3 brownish-grey zones) with the reference solution.

Homogenize 100 g honey in a flask, close tightly, place in a water bath at 50 +/- 0.2 C until sugar crystals dissolve; cool to 20 C and re-homogenize; cover the prism of a calibrated refractometer with the sample; read the refractive index after 4 min.

details.reference: BP Appendix V E (Determination of Refractive Index)

tests.procedure: Take the water content from the refractive index using Table 2051.-1 (see details). Dissolve an amount of sample equivalent to 20.0 g honey dry solids in water to 100.0 mL. Measure conductivity with a calibrated conductivity meter.

Take the water content from the refractive index using Table 2051.-1 (same table as conductivity). Dissolve an amount equivalent to 20.0 g honey dry solids in 50 mL water; add 0.2 mL concentrated ammonia; dilute to 100.0 mL with water; decolorize with activated charcoal if necessary. Measure with a calibrated polarimeter.

details.reference: BP Appendix V F (Determination of Optical Rotation and Specific Optical Rotation)

tests.procedure: Take the water content from the refractive index using Table 2051.-1. Dissolve an amount equivalent to 5.0 g honey dry solids in 25 mL water; transfer to a 50.0 mL flask; add 0.5 mL 150 g/L potassium ferrocyanide, mix; add 0.5 mL 300 g/L zinc acetate, mix; dilute to 50.0 mL with water (a drop of ethanol may be added); filter. Transfer 5.0 mL of filtrate into each of 2 tubes: test tube + 5.0 mL water; reference tube + 5.0 mL 2.0 g/L sodium hydrogen sulfite. Read absorbance of test against reference at 284 nm and 336 nm within 60 min. If A284 is above 0.8, dilute both solutions to bring A284 below 0.8. HMF (ppm) = (A1 - A2) x D x 149.7, where A1 = absorbance at 284 nm, A2 = absorbance at 336 nm, D = dilution factor (where applicable).

details.reference: BP Appendix II B (Ultraviolet and Visible Absorption Spectrophotometry)

tests.procedure: Chlorides limit test by opalescence comparison. Test solution: 15 mL of 10 g/L sample solution; add 1 mL dilute nitric acid and pour as one addition into a tube with 1 mL silver nitrate solution R2. Standard: 10 mL chloride standard solution (5 ppm Cl) and 5 mL water, same reagents. Examine laterally against black background; after 5 min protected from light, opalescence of test not more intense than standard.

details.reference: BP Appendix VII Limit Tests, Chloride

tests.procedure: Sulfates limit test by opalescence comparison. Test solution: 15 mL of 40 g/L sample solution; add 0.5 mL acetic acid and 3 mL 250 g/L barium chloride. Standard: 3 mL 250 g/L barium chloride added to 4.5 mL sulfate standard solution (10 ppm SO4); add 0.5 mL acetic acid; shake, stand 1 min. After 5 min, opalescence of test not more intense than standard.

details.reference: BP Appendix VII Limit Tests, Sulfate

tests.procedure: Weigh 10 g sample and dissolve in SCDB to 100 mL (warm at most 45 C, not more than 45 min); process within 1 h. Pipette 1 mL of dilution into each of 4 plates: 2 SCDA and 2 SDA. SCDA incubated 3-5 days at 30-35 C (TAMC); SDA 5-7 days at 20-25 C (TYMC). Total count (CFU/g) = (colonies plate 1 + colonies plate 2) / 2 x DF, DF = 10.

details.reference: USP 2024 <61> Microbiological Examination of Nonsterile Products: Microbial Enumeration Tests

tests.procedure: Same preparation as TAMC: SDA plates incubated 5-7 days at 20-25 C; total count as for TAMC (DF = 10).

details.reference: USP 2024 <61> Microbiological Examination of Nonsterile Products: Microbial Enumeration Tests

tests.procedure: From the SCDB preparation: incubate 24-48 h at 30-35 C; transfer 1 mL to 10 mL MacConkey broth, 42-44 C 24-48 h; subculture on MacConkey agar 30-35 C 18-24 h. Confirm: Gram stain (gram-negative short rods); EMB dark-centred colonies; TBX blue or green colonies at 42-44 C 18-72 h; identity by identification system (report if probability above 70 %).

From the SCDB preparation: incubate 18-24 h at 30-35 C; transfer 1 mL to 10 mL Rappaport Vassiliadis broth (RVS), 30-35 C 18-24 h; subculture on XLD, BGA and/or HEA, 30-35 C 24-48 h. Confirm: Gram stain of XLD colonies; TSI slant (red alkaline slope and yellow acid butt, with or without blackening, confirms); identity by identification system (report if probability above 70 %).
